route.title: One event, {many stops}.
text: Map out the route, put a host at every checkpoint, and watch everyone collect their stamps along the way.
route.imageAlt: Illustration of a small city with a meeting point and seven checkpoints, each with a host and a game: tug-of-war, Mölkky, ball toss, a photo challenge, a sack race, a quiz and a rope jump. Groups leave the meeting point, check in with the host at each checkpoint by scanning a QR code on their phone, and come back.

goal.title: Why {Bonfiire}
text: Bonfiire is the app built for students who want to hang out, do things and make unforgettable memories. Whether it's an Appro crawl across the city, a Fuksiaiset event for freshmen, a spontaneous park hangout, or a house party — Bonfiire helps you find it, organize it, and save all the moments.

why.title: Everything you need, in {Bonfiire}
text: Find something to do, meet new people, host your own events and keep the friendships going. All in one app.

features.title: Discover events
features.text: Find exciting local activities and events happening around you. From coffee meetups to adventure sports.

features.title: Connect with people
features.text: Meet like-minded individuals who share your interests. Build genuine friendships that last.

features.title: Host your own event
features.text: Manage your own events and bring your community together. Be the spark that ignites connections.

features.title: Build community
features.text: Keep in touch with the people you meet and turn one event into many.

eventTypes.title: Events on {Bonfiire}
text: Whether it is locked to one cozy location or spans an entire city, Bonfiire handles it seamlessly.

items.title: Single Venue Event
text: Perfect for classic gatherings. Drop a pin, send out the invites, and welcome your people in for a house party, park chill, or birthday celebration.
items.imageAlt: A small group meeting up on a sunny autumn day

items.title: Multi-checkpoints event
text: Built for movement and scale. Map out an epic route, checkpoint hosts at every stop, and let participants collect stamps along the way.
items.imageAlt: Two friends checking the route on their phones

photoBreak.imageAlt: Students laughing during a tug-of-war in the park
photoBreak.quote: Somewhere between the first hello and the last laugh, strangers become friends.

finale.title: Let's start making memories.
text: Student life goes fast. Don't waste it.
